The curriculum includes **69 required credits**—such as **BLDC 3050 Building Envelope Performance**, **BLDC 3300 Estimating 3**, and **BLDG 1830 BC Building Code: Part 3 Introduction**—plus at least **6 elective credits** from the approved pool.

Graduates may continue into the Bachelor of Technology in Construction Management.
